issues.title: Enable Editing of Profile Fields on Registration Page
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI modifies the user self-registration page to make profile fields (like name and email) editable. Currently, these fields are populated from the EAMS-A authentication service and are read-only. Due to data quality issues from the source, this change will empower users to correct their own information during the registration process.

---

### User Story

*   **As a** new user registering for ORBIT,
*   **I want to** be able to edit my name and email on the registration form,
*   **so that** I can correct any outdated or incorrect information provided by the authentication service and ensure my profile data is accurate from day one.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

#### **Scenario 1: Page Loads with Editable Fields**

*   **Given** a new user lands on the "User Registration" page after authenticating,
*   **When** the page loads,
*   **Then** the profile fields (e.g., "First Name", "Last Name", "Email") **must** be populated with the data from EAMS-A as they are today.
*   **And** these fields **must** now be enabled and fully editable, allowing the user to change the pre-populated values.
*   **And** the fields **must not** have a read-only visual style (i.e., no greyed-out background).

#### **Scenario 2: User Saves Edited Information**

*   **Given** a user is on the registration page,
*   **And** they have modified one or more of the pre-populated profile fields (e.g., changed their last name),
*   **When** they complete the rest of the form and click "Register",
*   **Then** the system **must** save the user's manually entered/corrected values to their new ORBIT profile in the database, overriding the original data from EAMS-A.

#### **Scenario 3: User Does Not Edit Information (Regression Check)**

*   **Given** a user is on the registration page,
*   **And** the data from EAMS-A is correct and they do not make any changes to the profile fields,
*   **When** they complete the rest of the form and click "Register",
*   **Then** the system **must** save the original, pre-populated values to their new ORBIT profile, as it does today.
